newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures untraded in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures untraded in dull market.

text.p: Rubber futures were untraded by midsession on Monday in dull trade with players hoping for some shortcovering in the afternoon to perk up the local market, dealers said.
"There were no trades done this morning. You could not see any offtake at all. It was very, very quiet," a local rubber trader said.

Dealers said the mixed performance of the Japanese market failed to provide any inspiration to the local market. Japan's benchmark June contract inched up 0.2 yen to 147.7 while Kobe's June contract dipped 0.3 yen to 147.6 in the morning session.
"We're hoping for a better market this afternoon," one dealer said. "This morning was very dead."
At around 0445 GMT, March RSS3 was indicated at 122.50-124.50 U.S. cents a kg from last Friday's settlement of 123.50 cents.
March RSS1 was indicated at 174.50-176.50 Singapore cents (US$1.24-$1.26) a kg from the previous 176.25 cents.
March TSR20 was indicated at 168.50-170.50 Singapore cents (US$1.20-$1.22) a kg from the previous 170.00 cents.
